commands:
test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq '.private')
test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo 'Visibility changed; dispatch fresh validation under the current policy'; exit 1; }
make install
npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs ci
cd onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
python3 scripts/bootstrap_env.py
ONESA_CHAT_PORT=3100 ONESA_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3100 docker compose up --build --wait
node scripts/docs/capture.mjs
npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs run test:security
npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs audit --audit-level=low
make docs-assets docs-public
.venv/bin/python scripts/docs/validate.py --staged
git diff --exit-code -- docs/api/openapi.json docs/diagrams/database.mmd docs/public/examples.md
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Icons(HTMLParser):
    found = False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'link' and attrs.get('rel') == 'icon' and attrs.get('href') == '/favicon.ico':
            self.found = True
app = Path('onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs')
parser = Icons()
parser.feed((app / 'build-public/index.html').read_text())
assert parser.found, 'Public index is missing the favicon link'
icon = (app / 'build-public/favicon.ico').read_bytes()
assert icon == (app / 'static/favicon.ico').read_bytes()
assert icon[:4] == b'\x00\x00\x01\x00', 'Invalid ICO header'
print('Public index favicon link and bundled image verified.')
PYTHON
docker compose down
flags=()
if [ "$CREATE_PROJECT" = true ]; then flags+=(--create); fi
.venv/bin/python scripts/docs/vercel_host.py prepare "${flags[@]}"
set -eu
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/onesa-docs/.vercel/output/static"
cp onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/vercel.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/onesa-docs/vercel.json"
cp -a onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/build-public/. "$RUNNER_TEMP/onesa-docs/.vercel/output/static/"
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
routes = []
if os.environ['DEPLOY_TARGET'] == 'preview':
    routes.append({'src': '/(.*)', 'headers': {'X-Robots-Tag': 'noindex, nofollow'}, 'continue': True})
routes.extend([{'handle': 'filesystem'}, {'src': '/((?:[^/]+/)*[^/.]+)', 'dest': '/$1.html'}, {'src': '/.*', 'dest': '/404.html', 'status': 404}])
path = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'onesa-docs/.vercel/output/config.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps({'version': 3, 'routes': routes}) + '\n')
PYTHON
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/onesa-docs"
flags=()
if [ "$DEPLOY_TARGET" = production ]; then flags+=(--prod); fi
npm exec --yes --package=vercel@63.1.0 -- vercel deploy --prebuilt --yes "${flags[@]}" --token="$VERCEL_TOKEN" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/onesa-docs-url.txt"
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/onesa-docs-url.txt" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
.venv/bin/python scripts/docs/vercel_host.py domain | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
